### Session Abstract & Key Takeaways

In this deep-dive session, attendees will discover how to orchestrate multi-agent LLM systems on Kubernetes using KubeRay and vLLM.

Key Takeaways:
1. Architecture of GPU-accelerated inference pools on K8s
2. Autoscaling worker pools based on token queue depth
3. Practical lessons deploying local models with zero downtime

### Speaker Bio
